analysis: Documentation-only changes in docs/developer/test.md (head lines 729-746 added) and docs/developer/threat-model-review.md. Neither file changes provider runtime code, the coordinator-provider WebSocket contract (TB-002), App Attest authorization (TB-011) or any key/attestation handling. The unit for test.md head lines 486-1024 is mostly unchanged surrounding text; its App Attest, endpoint-resumption, logout and worker test descriptions are consistent with TB-011/T-053 as stated and do not weaken or reinterpret them. Changed behavior is described only for the PR-review tooling: manual dispatch is limited to the unpaid preflight, paid scans run on automatic PR events, and job reruns start no paid work. Workload call admission uses a 500-call emergency ceiling, 16,384 default output tokens, a 50-minute scan deadline inside a 60-minute job, and a 600-second per-request timeout. Depth routing sends critical paths to Sol and risky production paths to Opus, with no duplicate Opus pass before Sol. Test-named and docs files keep full Sonnet coverage and integration, and they escalate on findings or uncertainty. The docs say human-review handoffs do not activate conditional clearance or auto-merge, and that membership removal requires independent human review instead of a rerun. These are descriptions only: the scanner code, workflow YAML, depth_policy.py and merge_policy.py are not in the supplied units, so I cannot verify that they enforce the stated behavior. One residual concern is that routing heuristics for test-named files could under-review a security-critical file if misclassified, but the docs say Production AppAttest.swift, Attest.swift and AuthLatest.swift and critical test-named files outside support trees retain depth. That is a claim to verify against the actual scanner implementation, not a finding here. No evidence of a regression against the provider threat-model assets or boundaries. Cited line numbers: test.md 729-746 (head) and threat-model-review.md changed ranges per the patch. needs_deeper_review is false because the PR is docs-only for these units.
